sh -c 'trap '\''exit 0'\'' HUP INT TERM; encoded_script=$1; shift; eval "$(printf '\''%b'\'' "$encoded_script")"; exit 0' station-popup-binding 'set +e\nset -f\nbinding_client_name=$1\nbinding_client_pid=$2\nbinding_client_session=$3\ntmux_bin='\''/usr/bin/tmux'\''\nfallback_alias='\''/opt/station/bin/stn-tmux-popup'\''\nconfig_path='\'''\''\ninstalled_root='\''/opt/station/bin'\''\nsession_name='\''_station-ui'\''\nexpected_root_sha='\''69522055866e73169dd4376c1c6f953a29ece4862d81664c21bd0571214af3d4'\''\nexpected_session_sha='\''c0705fb50cadfb17f93f3cf6cebcc0e35ac5562f2bc8edc6a5d70b5abf343544'\''\nexpected_signature_sha='\''c081fc4d344e6b7995c55913c27667519ba3150b703f5837a331e0aaa53a4433'\''\nattach_arg='\'''\''\\'\'''\''env -u TMUX '\''\\'\'''\''\\'\''\\'\'''\'''\''\\'\'''\''/usr/bin/tmux'\''\\'\'''\''\\'\''\\'\'''\'''\''\\'\'''\'' -T hyperlinks attach-session -t '\''\\'\'''\''\\'\''\\'\'''\'''\''\\'\'''\''_station-ui'\''\\'\'''\''\\'\''\\'\'''\'''\''\\'\'''\'''\''\\'\'''\'''\''\npopup_width='\''50%'\''\npopup_height='\''50%'\''\npopup_status='\''off'\''\nfmt='\''#'\''\nsep=$(printf '\''\\037'\'')\ntrap '\''exit 0'\'' HUP INT TERM\n\nfallback_popup() {\n  fallback_client_name=${client_name:-$binding_client_name}\n  if [ -n "$config_path" ]; then\n    if valid_client_name "$fallback_client_name"; then\n      STATION_CONFIG_PATH=$config_path STATION_FOCUS_CLIENT_ID=$fallback_client_name "$fallback_alias" --config "$config_path" >/dev/null 2>&1\n    else\n      STATION_CONFIG_PATH=$config_path "$fallback_alias" --config "$config_path" >/dev/null 2>&1\n    fi\n  elif valid_client_name "$fallback_client_name"; then\n    STATION_FOCUS_CLIENT_ID=$fallback_client_name "$fallback_alias" >/dev/null 2>&1\n  else\n    "$fallback_alias" >/dev/null 2>&1\n  fi\n  fallback_status=$?\n  case "$fallback_status" in\n    0|129) return 0 ;;\n  esac\n  "$tmux_bin" display-message -d 3000 '\''Station popup failed; run stn popup for details'\'' >/dev/null 2>&1 || :\n  return 0\n}\n\nvalid_nonce() {\n  [ "${#1}" -eq 32 ] || return 1\n  case "$1" in *[!0-9a-f]*) return 1 ;; esac\n  return 0\n}\n\nvalid_client_pid() {\n  case "$1" in '\'''\''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac\n  [ "${#1}" -le 10 ] || return 1\n  case "$1" in 0*) return 1 ;; esac\n  [ "$1" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || return 1\n  [ "$1" -le 2147483647 ] 2>/dev/null || return 1\n  return 0\n}\n\nvalid_client_name() {\n  [ -n "$1" ] && [ "${#1}" -le 128 ] || return 1\n  case "$1" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_/@%+=:-]*) return 1 ;; esac\n  return 0\n}\n\nsha256_value() {\n  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    digest=$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$1" | sha256sum 2>/dev/null) || return 1\n  elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    digest=$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$1" | shasum -a 256 2>/dev/null) || return 1\n  else\n    return 1\n  fi\n  set -- $digest\n  [ "${#1}" -eq 64 ] || return 1\n  case "$1" in *[!0-9a-f]*) return 1 ;; esac\n  printf '\''%s'\'' "$1"\n}\n\ndev_registration_is_live() {\n  [ -n "$dev_session$dev_command$dev_owner$dev_root" ] || return 1\n  owner_pid=${dev_owner%%:*}\n  case "$owner_pid" in '\'''\''|*[!0-9]*) return 0 ;; esac\n  [ "$owner_pid" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || return 0\n  if kill -0 "$owner_pid" 2>/dev/null; then\n    return 0\n  fi\n  # A denied signal probe is inconclusive; only a working process table may prove absence.\n  command -v ps >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0\n  ps -p "$$" -o pid= >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0\n  ps -p "$owner_pid" -o pid= >/dev/null 2>&1\n}\n\nparse_route() {\n  old_ifs=$IFS\n  IFS=.\n  set -- $route\n  IFS=$old_ifs\n  [ "$#" -eq 6 ] || return 1\n  [ "$1" = v1 ] && [ "$2" = n ] || return 1\n  [ "$3" = "$expected_root_sha" ] || return 1\n  [ "$4" = "$expected_session_sha" ] || return 1\n  [ "$5" = "$registered_signature_sha" ] || return 1\n  valid_nonce "$6" || return 1\n  registration_nonce=$6\n  return 0\n}\n\nparse_claim() {\n  claim_state=\n  claim_registration_nonce=\n  claim_action_nonce=\n  claim_client_pid=\n  claim_client_name=\n  [ -n "$claim" ] || return 0\n  old_ifs=$IFS\n  IFS=.\n  set -- $claim\n  IFS=$old_ifs\n  [ "$#" -eq 6 ] || return 1\n  [ "$1" = v1 ] || return 1\n  case "$2" in open|closing) claim_state=$2 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac\n  valid_nonce "$3" || return 1\n  valid_nonce "$4" || return 1\n  valid_client_pid "$5" || return 1\n  valid_client_name "$6" || return 1\n  claim_registration_nonce=$3\n  claim_action_nonce=$4\n  claim_client_pid=$5\n  claim_client_name=$6\n  return 0\n}\n\nclear_exact_claim() {\n  exact_claim=$1\n  exact_client=$2\n  clear_condition="${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_active_claim},$exact_claim}"\n  clear_commands="set-option -gq -u @station_popup_active_claim ; if-shell -F \\"${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_client},$exact_client}\\" \\"set-option -gq -u @station_popup_client\\" ; if-shell -F \\"${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_focus_client},$exact_client}\\" \\"set-option -gq -u @station_popup_focus_client\\""\n  "$tmux_bin" if-shell -F -t "$session_name:" "$clear_condition" "$clear_commands" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :\n}\n\nrun_action() {\n  expected_claim=$1\n  new_claim=$2\n  action_kind=$3\n  previous_client=$4\n  action_condition="${fmt}{&&:${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_route},$route},${fmt}{&&:${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_lease},$route},${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_active_claim},$expected_claim}}}"\n  clear_condition="${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_active_claim},$new_claim}"\n  clear_commands="set-option -gq -u @station_popup_active_claim ; if-shell -F \\"${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_client},$claim_target_client}\\" \\"set-option -gq -u @station_popup_client\\" ; if-shell -F \\"${fmt}{==:${fmt}{@station_popup_focus_client},$claim_target_client}\\" \\"set-option -gq -u @station_popup_focus_client\\""\n  finish="if-shell -F '\''$clear_condition'\'' '\''$clear_commands'\''"\n  prefix="set-option -gq @station_popup_active_claim $new_claim ; set-option -gq @station_popup_client $claim_target_client ; set-option -gq @station_popup_focus_client $claim_target_client"\n  case "$action_kind" in\n    open)\n      action="$prefix ; set-option -t $session_name mouse on ; set-option -t $session_name status $popup_status ; display-popup -c $client_name -w $popup_width -h $popup_height -E $attach_arg ; $finish"\n      ;;\n    replace)\n      action="$prefix ; display-popup -c $previous_client -C ; set-option -t $session_name mouse on ; set-option -t $session_name status $popup_status ; display-popup -c $client_name -w $popup_width -h $popup_height -E $attach_arg ; $finish"\n      ;;\n    close)\n      action="$prefix ; display-popup -c $previous_client -C ; $finish"\n      ;;\n    *) return 1 ;;\n  esac\n  action_output=$("$tmux_bin" if-shell -F -t "$session_name:" "$action_condition" "$action" '\''display-message -p STATION_POPUP_CAS_MISS'\'' 2>/dev/null)\n  action_status=$?\n  if [ "$action_output" = STATION_POPUP_CAS_MISS ]; then\n    return 2\n  fi\n  case "$action_status" in\n    0|129) return 0 ;;\n  esac\n  clear_exact_claim "$new_claim" "$claim_target_client"\n  return 1\n}\n\ntry_fast_popup() {\n  valid_client_name "$binding_client_name" || return 1\n  valid_client_pid "$binding_client_pid" || return 1\n  [ -n "$binding_client_session" ] && [ "${#binding_client_session}" -le 256 ] || return 1\n  snapshot_format="${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_route}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_lease}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_active_claim}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_signature}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_session_name}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_expected_signature}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_ui_root}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_client}${sep}${fmt}{@station_popup_focus_client}${sep}${fmt}{@station_tui_dev_session_name}${sep}${fmt}{@station_tui_dev_command}${sep}${fmt}{@station_tui_dev_owner}${sep}${fmt}{@station_tui_dev_root}${sep}v1"\n  snapshot=$("$tmux_bin" display-message -p -t "$session_name:" "$snapshot_format" 2>/dev/null) || return 1\n  old_ifs=$IFS\n  IFS="$sep"\n  set -- $snapshot\n  IFS=$old_ifs\n  [ "$#" -eq 14 ] || return 1\n  route=$1\n  lease=$2\n  claim=$3\n  session_signature=$4\n  registered_session=$5\n  registered_signature=$6\n  registered_root=$7\n  active_client=$8\n  focus_client=$9\n  shift 9\n  dev_session=$1\n  dev_command=$2\n  dev_owner=$3\n  dev_root=$4\n  snapshot_version=$5\n  [ "$snapshot_version" = v1 ] || return 1\n  client_pid=$binding_client_pid\n  client_name=$binding_client_name\n  client_session=$binding_client_session\n\n  if dev_registration_is_live; then\n    return 1\n  fi\n  [ -n "$route" ] && [ "$lease" = "$route" ] || return 1\n  [ "$session_signature" = "$registered_signature" ] || return 1\n  [ "${#registered_signature}" -le 4096 ] || return 1\n  case "$registered_signature" in v2:*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac\n  registered_signature_sha=$(sha256_value "$registered_signature") || return 1\n  [ "$registered_signature_sha" = "$expected_signature_sha" ] || return 1\n  parse_route || return 1\n  [ "$registered_session" = "$session_name" ] || return 1\n  [ "$registered_root" = "$installed_root" ] || return 1\n  parse_claim || return 1\n\n  if [ -z "$claim" ]; then\n    [ -z "$active_client$focus_client" ] || return 1\n  else\n    [ "$claim_registration_nonce" = "$registration_nonce" ] || return 1\n    [ "$active_client" = "$claim_client_name" ] || return 1\n    [ "$focus_client" = "$claim_client_name" ] || return 1\n    [ "$claim_state" = open ] || return 2\n  fi\n\n  action_nonce=$(od -An -N16 -tx1 /dev/urandom 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\'' \n'\'')\n  valid_nonce "$action_nonce" || return 1\n\n  if [ -n "$claim" ] && { [ "$claim_client_pid" = "$client_pid" ] && [ "$claim_client_name" = "$client_name" ]; }; then\n    claim_target_client=$claim_client_name\n    next_claim="v1.closing.$registration_nonce.$action_nonce.$claim_client_pid.$claim_client_name"\n    run_action "$claim" "$next_claim" close "$claim_client_name"\n    return $?\n  fi\n  if [ -n "$claim" ] && [ "$client_session" = "$session_name" ]; then\n    claim_target_client=$claim_client_name\n    next_claim="v1.closing.$registration_nonce.$action_nonce.$claim_client_pid.$claim_client_name"\n    run_action "$claim" "$next_claim" close "$claim_client_name"\n    return $?\n  fi\n\n  claim_target_client=$client_name\n  next_claim="v1.open.$registration_nonce.$action_nonce.$client_pid.$client_name"\n  if [ -n "$claim" ]; then\n    run_action "$claim" "$next_claim" replace "$claim_client_name"\n  else\n    run_action '\'''\'' "$next_claim" open '\'''\''\n  fi\n}\n\nattempt=1\nwhile [ "$attempt" -le 2 ]; do\n  try_fast_popup\n  fast_status=$?\n  case "$fast_status" in\n    0) exit 0 ;;\n    2) attempt=$((attempt + 1)); continue ;;\n    *) break ;;\n  esac\ndone\nfallback_popup\nexit 0' #{q:client_name} #{client_pid} #{q:client_session} >/dev/null 2>&1
